newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star Q4 same store sales declined.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star Q4 same store sales declined.

text.p: Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Inc said Tuesday its comparable store sales declined three percent in the fourth quarter and decreased 1.9 percent for the year.
Earlier, Lone Star reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.56 a share, up from $0.42 a year ago.

"We are particularly pleased with the continued margin inprovement at the restaurant level, driven primarily by a reduction in management staffing levels, and an on-going focus on narrowing the range of profitability of all units in the company, while simultaneously increasing the average profit performance of all restaurants," John White, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
Lone Star said it now has 20 Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon restaurants in Australia, which are profitable.
During the fourth quarter, 25 additional domestic Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon restaurants opened in 20 new markets.
The company owns 205 domestic Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Restaurants, as well as two Sullivan's Steakhouse restaurants and two Del Frisco's Double Eagle Steak House restaurants.
